## Relationships

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adella--faith.md)

Adella and [Faith](../character/faith.md) have been best friends since their school days. During a period when the adults are away or incapacitated, [Faith](../character/faith.md) attempts to manage the manse alongside [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), though her ill-advised rug-shaking in the graveyard results in local scandal.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P10](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P35](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0035), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P38](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0038), +2 more_
